name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the declaration of principles for a gender-equal society
part_text:
The European Parliament says it supports women's rights and gender equality. It welcomes the European Commission's March 2025 plan for women's rights and the list of principles attached to it. It backs those principles. It asks the Commission to take Parliament's views into account when writing the next gender equality strategy, which will run after 2025. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament states its support for the Commission's principles.
- It affects the Commission, which is asked to listen to Parliament's views.
- Next, Parliament's position feeds into the new gender equality strategy after 2025.
